title: Tracking area updating procedure (S1 mode only)

entities.name: Tracking Area Updating Procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by UE in S1 mode to update tracking area information with the network.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by network to accept tracking area update request.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to complete tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where UE is registered with the network.

relations.description: Tracking area updating procedure begins with UE sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
Network responds with TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message during tracking area updating procedure.
UE completes tracking area updating procedure by sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message.
Tracking area updating procedure requires UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED state.
